rationale: The current best already smooths float-kept and projection tensors late in training, but it leaves the large transposed `mlp.fc.weight` matrices in the recurrent tail unsmoothed even though earlier MLX runs found tail MLP-FC EMA helpful for final int8 roundtrip quality. This change keeps the winning recurrent-tail/QK setup intact and only extends the late EMA tracker to the recurrent tail expansion weights, targeting the final quantized metric without increasing artifact bytes or changing hot-path shapes.
title: Recurrent-Tail MLP-FC EMA Finalizer
